metadata.audience: Platform engineering leaders at regulated B2B software companies
metadata.buyingTrigger: A release is delayed while teams assemble compliance evidence by hand
metadata.alternatives: Manual release checklists, spreadsheets, internal scripts, or delaying the release
metadata.suppliedEvidence: Fictional product behavior and pilot evidence created only for testing this evaluator.

sourceMessaging:
Ship regulated software without rebuilding the audit trail by hand.

ReleaseGuard gives platform engineering leaders one review queue for deployment evidence, policy checks, and named approvals. AI-assisted checks flag missing evidence against policies your team configures; your release owner makes the final decision. In a 12-team pilot, audit-packet preparation fell from a median of four hours to 45 minutes. Results will vary by workflow and policy complexity.
